title: thalictrum simplex subsp. galioides
intro: Thalictrum simplex subsp. galioides, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial actions, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, its bioactive compounds may also possess anticancer and immunomodulatory activities, highlighting the plant's potential in traditional medicine and modern pharmacology.
